chapter_seo_title: Dao Gui Yi Xian Ch. 241: The Lion Dance Palace – Betrayal & Blood
chapter_meta_description: Li Huowang discovers Han Fu’s “exit” is a trap: the Lion Dance Palace, lair of a hundred Lion-Masks. A desperate chase, brutal duels, and Bai Lingmiao’s rescue unfold.
og_title: Trapped in the Lion Dance Palace – Chapter 241
og_description: Li Huowang faces a wall of giant, living masks. Han Fu’s betrayal sends the group hurtling into a nightmare of endless pursuit.
twitter_description: No exit, no mercy—just a hundred Lion-Masks and a two-headed traitor. Li Huowang’s worst fears come true.

lore_anchors.definition: The main stronghold of the Lion-Masks, a corrupted sect whose members have fused with lion-dance costumes. Its name inverts a festive performance tradition into a horror lair.
A ritual Daoist weapon made of coins threaded with red string, traditionally used for exorcism. In this chapter, it can scatter and reassemble to bypass blocks.
A rare and valuable human constitution in the Dao-Twisted World, making the bearer a target for alchemists and cultivators who seek to exploit their nature.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Why did Han Fu lead them to the Lion Dance Palace?
cultural_notes_faq.a: He was never an ally; his goal was to use the Lion-Masks to kill Li Huowang and the group without risking a direct fight he might lose.

cultural_notes_faq.q: What is the Lion Dance Palace's origin?
cultural_notes_faq.a: It is likely a sect that has corrupted the traditional Chinese lion-dance performance into a living, parasitic body-horror; the "lion-masks" are now fused with human faces.
